footer.note: BrahminBooking facilitates requests. Ritual guidance and final arrangements are confirmed directly with the assigned Purohit.

home.panchangLede: See the character of the day, understand meaningful timings, and when the moment is right, find a trusted Purohit for your family.
home.sourceCopy: This homepage currently uses a clearly labelled development fixture. Live values will always show their calculation source, location and freshness.
home.pathwaysCopy: Start with the need you already understand. We will help with the rest.
home.pathwayCeremonyCopy: Share the occasion, place, language and preferred date for human-assisted coordination.
home.pathwayRitualTitle: I want to understand a ritual
home.pathwayRitualCopy: Read respectful, reviewed introductions before speaking with your family Purohit.
home.pathwayObservanceCopy: Explore festival context while keeping regional and calendar variations visible.
home.heroKicker: A more thoughtful way to honour tradition
home.heroLede: Find verified Purohits and temples for pujas, samskaras and sacred occasions—at home, at a temple or from wherever you are.
home.fixture: Development fixture · Not for religious decisions
home.pujaCopy: Commonly associated with an auspicious beginning. This development mapping is not a personalized religious recommendation.
home.fixtureStrip: Development fixtures are isolated from approved editorial guides and are never generated by an LLM at request time.
home.ritualIntro: Clear, respectful preparation notes—what the ritual signifies, what families commonly arrange, and what to confirm with your Purohit.
home.ritual1Note: For a considered beginning in a new home
home.ritual2Note: A prayer of gratitude, wellbeing and resolve
home.ritual3Note: Wedding rites guided by family tradition
home.verificationCopy: Our supply network is being built through institutional relationships and documented human review. The exact checks completed should be visible—not collapsed into a vague claim.
home.identityCopy: Identity evidence can be reviewed privately.
home.referencesCopy: Religious and community references can be recorded separately.
home.affiliationCopy: Temple or institution claims can be verified and dated.
home.practiceCopy: Languages, traditions and services are documented for coordination.
home.processTitle: How a request becomes an arrangement.
home.step1Copy: No account or payment is required.
home.step2Copy: Language, tradition and location are considered.
home.step3Copy: A coordinator speaks with you and the Purohit.
home.calloutTitle: Tell us what your family needs.
home.calloutCopy: Share the occasion, place, language and preferred date. Our team will review your request and coordinate the next step—without asking you to create an account.
home.providerTitle: Serve more families through a trusted network.

library.pujaIntro: These reviewed introductions help families ask better questions. They do not replace guidance from the Purohit who will conduct your ceremony.
library.readyTitle: Request the right Purohit for your family.
library.festivalIntro: Festival dates and observances can vary by region, sampradaya and calendar convention. Each guide makes that variation visible.
library.planTitle: We’ll help coordinate the next step.
library.planCopy: Share your language, tradition, location and preferred date. No account is required.
library.dateTitle: Confirm for your place and tradition.
library.dateCopy: Use a trusted local Panchang or ask your Purohit before making religious arrangements.

panchang.pageIntro: Panchang timings depend on place, timezone and calculation convention. We show those assumptions beside every result.
panchang.fallback: Using a changeable fallback location until you choose one.
panchang.savedNow: Saved on this device. You can change it at any time.
panchang.unavailableLocation: Browser location is unavailable. Please choose a city.
panchang.usingCoordinates: Using browser coordinates for this session only.
panchang.permissionDenied: Location permission was not granted. Please choose a city instead.
panchang.unavailableCopy: We will never replace a failed result with fabricated data. Booking requests remain available.
panchang.fixtureCopy: Illustrative values only · Not for religious decisions

book.pageIntro: Tell us the essentials. A person from the BrahminBooking team will review the request and coordinate availability. Nothing is confirmed or charged today.
book.occasionCopy: Start with what you know. The team can help clarify the exact service.
book.preferencesCopy: These details help us coordinate manually with the right network.
book.contactCopy: No account is needed. Your details remain private and are used to coordinate this request.
book.name: Your name
book.whatsapp: This number is available on WhatsApp
book.whatsappCopy: We may use it for request coordination only.
book.notesPlaceholder: Family context, accessibility needs, preferred call time, or other details
book.reviewCopy: Please confirm these essentials. A request does not reserve a Purohit or create a charge.
book.consent: I consent to BrahminBooking contacting me to coordinate this request and handling these details under the privacy notice. I understand this is a request, not a confirmed booking.
book.submitNote: No payment now · No account required · Human follow-up
book.serviceUnavailable: Request service is not connected yet. Please return shortly or contact the team directly.
book.sendFailed: We could not send the request. Please check your connection and try again.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.consent: Consent is required so the team can coordinate your request.
errors.date: Choose a date or mark it flexible.

requested.contact: Our team expects to make first contact {time}. This is not yet a confirmed booking.
requested.missing: Your request receipt is stored only in the browser session that submitted it. If you have already closed that session, please use the reference shared by the team.
requested.reviewCopy: We check the details and any missing context.
requested.coordinatorCopy: We speak with you before suggesting the next step.
requested.arrangementCopy: Service, date and expectations are confirmed directly.
requested.account: Create an account to track your booking
requested.optional: Your request is already submitted. Creating an account is optional and lets you receive updates, manage details and view future bookings.

auth.title: Keep future requests together.
auth.intro: You never need an account to send a booking request. Sign in only if you want to save and claim eligible requests after verifying the same contact details.
auth.checkCopy: Use the secure sign-in link we sent. A reference number alone can never claim a private request.
auth.error: Sign-in is not connected yet or the link could not be sent. Your booking request is unaffected.
